```python
from docx import Document
p = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/cffe0e32-c9a6-4c52-9877-78ceb4aaa9fb.docx"
doc = Document(p)

# Extract profiles
profiles = {}
for i in range(len(doc.paragraphs)):
    line = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if ":" in line and any(n in line for n in ["Harry","Rebecca","Georgette","Micah","Perry","Tyson","Lucy","Jun","Sara","Miguel","Fred","Alex"]):
        name, rest = line.split(":",1)
        profiles[name.strip()] = [x.strip() for x in rest.split(",")]

# Extract gifts list
gifts = []
start = None
for i, para in enumerate(doc.paragraphs):
    if para.text.strip() == "Gifts:":
        start = i+1
        break
if start is not None:
    for i in range(start, len(doc.paragraphs)):
        t = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
        if not t:
            continue
        gifts.append(t)

gift_interest_map = {
    "Galileo Galilei biography": "Astronomy",
    "Fishing reel": "Fishing",
    "Raku programming guide": "Perl",
    "Chisel set": "Woodworking",
    "Custom dice": "Tabletop RPGs",
    "“War and Peace” American film copy": "Old Movies",
    "Yarn": "Knitting",
    "“One Piece” graphic novel": "Manga",
    "“War and Peace” novel": "Historical Fiction Novels",
    "Starbucks gift card": "Coffee",
    "Foam exercise mat": "Yoga"
}

matched = set()
for g, intr in gift_interest_map.items():
    for name, ints in profiles.items():
        if intr in ints:
            matched.add(name)

all_names = set(profiles.keys())
unmatched = sorted(list(all_names - matched))
print("Matched recipients:", sorted(list(matched)))
print("Unmatched (no gift):", unmatched)
```
